When a reentrant attacker withdraws (with contract externally funded F >= deposit d, so the reentrant call succeeds in the reference), a completed withdrawAll must pay out both the inner and outer claims, leaving c's balance strictly below F; the mutant zeroes credit before the call so the reentrant withdrawal is a silent no-op and c's balance stays exactly at F.

For any admissible input, once withdrawAll has started the reentrancy lock makes any re-entrant withdrawAll call from the recipient revert, so the contract pays out exactly each user's credited amount and address(c).balance afterwards equals deposits minus the attacker's single withdrawal; the mutant (lock never set) lets the attacker's receive() re-enter withdrawAll successfully and withdraw twice, draining an extra amount.
